question:
This should be going through our 6 game masters process and land on the council board.

We’re doing rolling shipping through KDP in batches in alignment with the plan for /ally/mom

verdicts.shaman: Batches are right; name the cadence to every backer before batch one and announce each batch on its day.
verdicts.architect: One monthly batch split 50/50 per the budget; Gumroad preorders ship from the new-sales half; the pace levers are Wendell's.
verdicts.challenger: Ship batch one and read its real cost; the budget's pace means a 2029 tail. Dissents: recycle from batch one.
verdicts.regent: Follow the budget, announce per batch, confirm addresses per batch; the backer order is reserved.
verdicts.diplomat: One message to backers with a reply path; releases welcomed, never asked. Dissents: hold signed sales until the first backer batch lands.
